What can I help with?You saidWhat is your return policy?Agent saidFaherty Brand Return Policy OverviewEligible Items: Most Faherty items can be returned or exchanged within 60 days of purchase, as long as they are unworn, unwashed, and have original tags attached.How to Start a Return: You can begin your return or exchange online through our Returns Center or at any Faherty store location.Refunds: Refunds are issued to the original form of payment once your return is processed.Return Methods: Drop off at a Return Bar for a quick, paperless refund.Mail-in returns (a $7 fee applies for shipping label returns).Final Sale Items: Items marked as Final Sale cannot be returned or exchanged.Holiday Extension: Purchases made between November 1 and December 1 have an extended return window until January 31.Questions for YouAre you looking to return an online or in-store purchase?Is your item marked as Final Sale?Do you need help starting your return?Let me know so I can guide you through the next steps!You saidHow many days do I have to return something?Agent saidReturn Window DetailsYou have 60 days from the date of purchase to return most Faherty items, as long as they are unworn, unwashed, and have original tags attached.For purchases made between November 1 and December 1, the return window is extended until January 31 to accommodate holiday shopping.If you have a specific item or order in mind, let me know and I can help with next steps!You saidHow do I start a return or an exchange?Agent saidHow to Start a Return or ExchangeFor online purchases: Visit our Returns Center and enter your order number and shipping ZIP code. Follow the prompts to select the item(s) you want to return or exchange.For in-store purchases: You can return or exchange your item at any Faherty Brand store location. If you can't visit a store, let me know and I can help escalate your request for a mail-in return.Quick QuestionsWas your purchase made online or in-store?Do you need help with a return or an exchange?Let me know so I can guide you through the next steps!You saidDo I have to pay for return shipping?Agent saidReturn Shipping FeesIf you choose to return your item by mail using a prepaid shipping label, there is a $7 fee deducted from your refund.If you return your item at a Return Bar location (using a QR code), there is no fee—this option is free and quick.Returns in-store are also free.Next StepsWould you like help finding a Return Bar location near you, or do you prefer to mail your return? Let me know how you'd like to proceed!You saidHow long until I get my refund once you receive it?Agent saidRefund Timing After ReturnIf you use a Return Bar (QR code drop-off): Your refund is triggered immediately once your item is scanned at the Return Bar. It typically appears in your account within 2–5 business days, depending on your bank.If you mail your return: Your refund is processed once your package is received and inspected at our warehouse. This can take about 7–15 business days after delivery, plus 2–5 business days for the refund to show up in your account.Would you like help starting a return or finding a Return Bar location near you?You saidCan I exchange for a different size or option instead of a refund?Agent saidExchanges for Different Sizes or OptionsYou can exchange your item for a different size or color directly through our Returns Center.For exchanges of a different style (not just size or color), you’ll need to process a standard return and then place a new order for the item you want.Quick StepsSelect the item for exchange in the portal.Choose your desired size or color.Your new item will ship out once your original item is received and inspected.Would you like help starting an e…
